other_conditions: must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
must have an active membership of the Board
eligible only after three months from registration
benefits are granted only once in a lifetime
must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding year
bicycles are provided to workers in plain areas
sewing machines are provided to workers or their dependents in mountainous/hilly areas
benefits_summary: Provides a bicycle to eligible construction workers in plain areas and a sewing machine to eligible workers or their dependents in mountainous/hilly areas.
